title: Private lab effects verified by others

tellings.quote: There are things that I've seen in private laboratories that are undeniable and verified by people other than myself in those facilities.

plain: Dave Rossi, a guest on an episode titled "Aliens Taught Me Advanced Physics!", says he has seen things in private laboratories that are "undeniable" and that other people in those facilities have checked, not only him. He tells Michels this as something he saw himself, though he does not say here what the effects were or where the labs are. If he is right, unexplained physical effects are being produced in private labs and confirmed by more than one witness.
